high.description: Strong worker for complex tasks: architecture, multi-file refactors, difficult bugs

medium.description: Standard worker for moderate tasks: feature implementation, component builds

low.description: Light worker for simple tasks: styling, docs, small fixes

validator.description: Runs tests, checks build, verifies changes, identifies regressions

verification.build: [e.g., npm run build, cargo build, python -m build]
verification.test: [e.g., npm run test, pytest, cargo test]
verification.lint: [e.g., npm run lint, ruff check, clippy]
